instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out which paid access one buyer holds right now: what they bought, what renewed, what ended or was refunded, and what I gave them by hand", and give it subject (The buyer, the way your access rules name a buyer (the starter rules: their email address)).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-who-holds-paid-access and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Folds the buyer's payment events (the payment-event records the payment tools keep) through your access-effect-rule rows into effects, folds those into purchase episodes (a purchase starts one, a renewal keeps it, a cancellation or refund ends it) and answers the access refs of the offers they hold now, with every offer that asks for no money held by everyone, plus the access-grant records you wrote for them (a gift, a pass with an end date).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: payment-event (records:list); record:commercial-offer (records:list); access-grant (records:list); access-effect-rule (records:list); effect-lifecycle (records:list).
